values.note: All sites $40 plus tax ($36 for Good Sam members), on the page's '2025 Camping Rates', still posted 2026-11-03. Special events such as Iowa Speedway race weekends $80 a night. Weekly and monthly rates by phone or email.

values.note: All 38 pull-through, level gravel: 1-15 are 18 ft wide and 65-85 ft long, 16-23 are 26 x 75 ft (some low branches), 24-38 are 33 x 85 ft and unshaded. Sites 11-15 have 20/30 amp only.

values.note: Online request form with a $5 card deposit; the reservation holds only once a confirmation email arrives. Same-day stays by phone. Free cancellation until 24 hours out. Race-week bookings are invoiced and paid in full, refundable only 90+ days out; the 2026 NASCAR weekend (August 5-10) needed 5 nights.

booking.source: https://kelloggrv.com/rates-reservations/ ('If you are wanting to make a reservation for today, please call'; 'August 5-10 (Nascar Weekend 5 night minimum stay required)'; 'Special Event Cancelation policy') + https://kelloggrv.com/book-now/ ('only be charged a $5 deposit'), read 2026-11-03

note: Transient travel park 1/4 mi off I-80 Exit 173, on 8.5 acres beside corn fields. AMOCO gas station, convenience store and Iowa's Best Burger Café on site; F-5 rated tornado shelter near the entrance. Monthly/long-term also offered but operates as a general transient RV park. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $40 ($36 GS, $80 race weekends), 50 amp full hookups, 38 pull-throughs up to 85 ft, showers/laundry/WiFi/store, operator booking form. Passes the gate. Season and dump not on the operator's pages (left alone).
